x-changelog.summary: Added update API for bulk replace requests
x-changelog.description:
NEW FEATURES:
- Added PUT /companies/{company_id}/workflows/bulk_replace_requests/{id} to update existing bulk replace requests
- Only temporary replacement requests can be updated (permanent requests cannot be modified)
- Supports updating assignees, workflow managers, dates, project roles, reason, project scope, and tool scope
- Allows partial updates - only provided fields will be updated
- Supports empty request body for retry functionality (re-queues async operation)
- Creates new async operation for each update, even if no changes are made
- Validates that all provided assignees and workflow managers are in the company directory
- Returns 202 Accepted with operation ID for tracking the background processing

x-changelog.description:
NEW FEATURES:
- Added GET /companies/{company_id}/workflows/bulk_replace_requests/{id}/errors to download CSV files with error details
- CSV files include project or company information, tool details, error types, and error messages
- Dynamic filename generation based on old assignee name (e.g., "replacement_errors_john_doe.csv")
- Requires Accept: text/csv header for CSV download
- Returns 404 Not Found if the bulk replace request is not found; if the request exists and has no errors, returns 200 with a JSON message
- Requires company admin access and bulk manage assignees granular permission
- CSV columns: Project or Company Name, Tool Name, Error Type, Error Message
- Proper HTTP headers for file download (Content-Type, Content-Disposition, Cache-Control)
